newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pan Pacific to write off S$9.5 mln losses.
newsitem.headline: Pan Pacific to write off S$9.5 mln losses.

text.p: Diversified publishing firm Pan Pacific Public Co Ltd said on Friday it would write off an investment of Singapore $9.5 million in its associate company Channel KTV because the company was being wound up.

The company said in a statement the write-off would result in a reduction in the net tangible assets per share of the company on a consolidated basis of S$0.17. The impact on the other businesses of the group would not be material, it said.
Channel KTV (karaoke television) broadcast music videos over satellites, cable television and in clubs and hotels.
Pan Pacific owns 33.3 percent of Channel KTV's redeemable preference shares and 40.81 percent of its ordinary shares.
"The business of Channel KTV has been performing poorly and efforts to raise further equity from existing shareholders and third parties were not successful," the statement said.
It said Channel KTV would convene an extraordinary general meeting at which a resolution would be passed for a voluntary winding up of the company.
